reuse.why: Implements the flag inside the existing shared linkBankSyncAccount, after its closed-account check, and shares the unlink field reset with the existing unlinkAccount handler via unlinkedAccountFields.

duplication.why: The reset fields are extracted once and used by both unlinkAccount and the replace path; the only repetition is the per-provider pass-through of the new option, which the wrapper structure requires.

placement.why: The takeover logic sits in the shared link routine in accounts/app.ts where the already-linked rule lives, and the reset constant sits beside the link param types.

scope.why: Only the option, the shared routine, the unlink extraction and focused tests change.

maintainability.why: A small, readable change in one routine; the six wrappers each having to forward the new option by hand is a mild maintenance cost of the existing destructuring style.

bypasses_abstraction.where: The previous holder is reset with the same unlinkedAccountFields as the unlinkAccount action, and all providers go through linkBankSyncAccount.

disguised_duplication.where: The unlink field reset is shared rather than copied; no reshaped copies.
